arabic text: BIBIYO SE SHEH KA KEHNA AAKHRI TUM PAR SALAM\nKOYI KYA LIKHEGA HALAT KHAYMA-E SHABBIR KI
english translation text: THE SHAH SAID TO THE LADIES: 'MY FINAL SALAM ON YOU'\nWHO CAN DESCRIBE THE STATE OF THE CAMP OF SHABBIR?

arabic text: SHEH NE ZAINAB SE KAHA BACHO SE REHNA HOSHIYAR\nAUR HIFAAZAT KARNA KHAWAR ABID-E DILGIR KI
english translation text: SAID THE KING UNTO ZAINAB: TAKE CARE OF THE CHILDREN\nAND PROTECT, O SISTER, THE BROKEN-HEARTED ABID

arabic text: BACHE GAR MARJAYE PHIR BHI BADUA KARNA NA TUM\nYEH WASIYAT BIBIYON SE THI SHAHE DILGIR KI
english translation text: AND DO NOT WISH THE PEOPLE ANY ILL, EVEN IF THE CHILDREN DIE\nTHIS WAS THE WILL OF THE BROKEN-HEARTED SHAH TO THE LADIES

arabic text: SHEH NE ASRARE IMAMAT KAR KE ABID KO SUPURD\nPHIR KHABAR DI BIBIYO KI KAYD KI ZANJIR KI
english translation text: HANDING OVER THE SECRETS OF IMAMATE TO ABID, THE SHAH\nGAVE THE LADIES TIDINGS OF IMPRISONMENT AND CHAINS

arabic text: BOLE SHEH KEHNA MERE SHIYO SE POHCHA KAR SALAAM\nKASH! TUM BHI DEKHTE HALAT MERE BESHIR KI
english translation text: SAID THE KING: GIVE SALAM TO MY SHIAS AND TELL THEM\nO WOULD YOU HAVE SEEN THE STATE OF MY INFANT CHILD!

arabic text: SHAH NE PEHNA LIBAS-E-KOHNA KAR KE KARTAR\nHONA URYAN LASH YE THI AARZO SHABBIR KI
english translation text: THE KING THEN WORE A DRESS, TORN AND SLASHED\nTO BE AN UNRECOGNIZABLE CORPSE WAS THE WISH OF SHABBIR

arabic text: BACHI GHODE KE KADAM SE LIPTI SHEH RONAY LAGAY\nSINE PER KUCH DER SOYI LADLI SHABBIR KI
english translation text: A LITTLE GIRL CURLED AROUND THE HORSE'S HOOVES\nAND ON HIS CHEST SHE LAY A WHILE, THE BELOVED OF SHABBIR
